name: IQAir AirVisual
tagline: Global air quality (AQI) and pollution data from monitoring stations and satellites.
description: IQAir AirVisual API provides real-time and historical air quality index (AQI), pollutant concentrations, and weather data from a global network of monitoring stations and satellite sources. Developers can query by city, nearest station, or geographic coordinates for applications that need pollution alerts, environmental dashboards, or health-related location insights.

auth.details: API key via query parameter key=YOUR_API_KEY (self-serve signup on IQAir platform).

use_cases: get current AQI for a city
find nearest air quality station by coordinates
list countries/states/cities with air quality data
get pollution and weather for a lat/lon location
